方芸猛地回过神。

许默不行了！

按她的技能条件，队友死了大不了再招一个。

但她没有放任许默走向衰亡。

一把将他那条几乎废掉的左臂架在自己的脖子上，咬紧牙关，半拖半抱地扛着这个血葫芦般的男人，跌跌撞撞地撞开营地那扇摇摇欲坠的门。

壁炉驱散了室内的阴冷。

角落的陶土盆里，原本在打瞌睡的小草被粗暴的开门声惊醒。

看清许默此刻惨状后，小草吓得浑身一哆嗦，两片叶子猛地捂住自己根茎。

方芸根本顾不上理会它，用尽力气，将许默平放在简陋的木床上。

刚刚触碰到床面，许默的身体便开始不受控制地剧烈痉挛。

体温在疯狂飙升，额头滚烫得吓人，眼睛此刻已然彻底涣散，陷入了深度的半昏迷状态。干裂起皮的嘴唇微微开合，含糊不清的呓语在死寂的房间里显得格外揪心。

“做到了……战利品收好……”

“别怕……”

“我会……保护你。”

方芸只觉得心里焦急又感动，隐约竟有泪水浮现。

在这鬼地方，别说拼命守护对方，队友之间不相互背后捅刀子，就已经是万幸。

绷带缠绕，缺医少药。

但幸好。

石屋营地内有着强大的生命值恢复buff。

许默的身体不再抽搐，但紧闭双眼，明显十分难受。

方芸不再犹豫，起身推门，再次闯入灰雾之中。

踩在黏稠的血泥里，发出令人反胃的黏腻声。她弯下腰，从一截断裂的狼肠旁拾起那枚沾满黑血的灰雾小晶块。

大拇指抹去面上的污渍，将那枚冰冷坚硬的晶体，死死攥在掌心，随后掷入虚无的存储空间。

许久。

睫毛微颤，许默缓缓睁开双眼。

没有往常那种触电般的警觉，也没有一睁眼就去摸刀的肌肉记忆，一股难以言喻的绵软与空虚感盘踞在四肢百骸。

以往在这鬼地方，只要天边泛起一丝亮光，他便会上了发条一般，瞬间弹起进入最高级别的战斗状态。

可今天，他的身体就像是生锈的齿轮，沉重得发涩。

他咬着牙撑起上半身，视线扫过昏暗的石屋。角落的另一张简易铺上，方芸蜷缩成一团睡得正沉。

她眉头即使在睡梦中也死死紧锁着。

Fang Yun suddenly came back to her senses.

Xu Mo can't do it anymore!

According to her skill conditions, if a teammate dies, she will have to recruit another one.

But she did not let Xu Mo go to decline.

He put his almost useless left arm around his neck, gritted his teeth, half dragged and half hugged the bloody gourd-like man, and stumbled open the rickety door of the camp.

The fireplace disperses the chill from the room.

In the clay pot in the corner, Xiaocao, who had been dozing off, was awakened by the rough sound of the door opening.

After seeing Xu Mo's miserable state clearly, Xiaocao trembled with fright and suddenly covered his stem with two leaves.

Fang Yun didn't care about it at all, and tried her best to lay Xu Mo flat on the simple wooden bed.

As soon as he touched the bed, Xu Mo's body began to spasm uncontrollably.

His body temperature was soaring crazily, his forehead was frighteningly hot, his eyes were completely blurry at this moment, and he fell into a deep semi-coma state.The chapped and peeling lips opened and closed slightly, and the inarticulate murmurs seemed particularly heart-wrenching in the dead silence of the room.

"I did it... put away the spoils..."

"Don't be afraid..."

"I will...protect you."

Fang Yun felt anxious and moved in her heart, and tears appeared vaguely.

In this hellish place, let alone protecting each other desperately, teammates are lucky enough not to stab each other in the back.

There are bandages and there is a lack of medical treatment.

But luckily.

There is a powerful health recovery buff in the Stone House Camp.

Xu Mo's body no longer twitched, but he closed his eyes tightly, obviously feeling very uncomfortable.

Fang Yun no longer hesitated, stood up and pushed the door open, breaking into the gray mist again.

Stepping on the thick blood mud made a stomach-turning sticky sound.She bent down and picked up the small gray mist crystal stained with black blood from the side of a broken wolf intestine.

Wipe off the stains on his face with his thumb, hold the cold and hard crystal tightly in his palm, and then throw it into the void storage space.

for a long time.

His eyelashes trembled slightly, and Xu Mo slowly opened his eyes.

There was no usual electric shock-like alertness, nor was there the muscle memory of touching the knife as soon as he opened his eyes. An indescribable feeling of softness and emptiness lingered in his limbs.

In the past, in this hellish place, as long as there was a glimmer of light on the horizon, he would be like clockwork and instantly jump into the highest level of combat status.

But today, his body was like a rusty gear, so heavy that it felt astringent.

He gritted his teeth and propped up his upper body, looking across the dim stone house.Another simple bunk was placed in the corner, and Fang Yun curled up in a ball and fell into a deep sleep.

Her brows were furrowed even in her sleep.
